title.zh: Claude参与破解40年生物学谜题：首次还原一种神秘蛋白质外壳
title.en: Claude参与破解40年生物学谜题：首次还原一种神秘蛋白质外壳

current_state.zh: Anthropic researchers used Claude to help identify, design, and structurally characterize Vault-like protein particles from bacteria and bacteriophages, producing the first three-dimensional model of a prokaryotic Vault particle and shortening purification from days to about 90 minutes.
current_state.en: Anthropic researchers used Claude to help identify, design, and structurally characterize Vault-like protein particles from bacteria and bacteriophages, producing the first three-dimensional model of a prokaryotic Vault particle and shortening purification from days to about 90 minutes.
